## Producing results and plots from real data

### Libraries

```{r}
library(AgeReading)
library(rstan)
library(ggplot2)
require(gridExtra)
library(loo)
library(bayesplot)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(cowplot)
library(fields)
library(bridgesampling)
```


### Loading result files

```{r}
Amin=3;Amax=12
A = Amax-Amin+1
R = 14

dir = "../../save_results/"
load(paste0(dir,"fitcomb0.year500000.RData"))              #reader dependent age errors
load(paste0(dir,"fitcomb1.year500000.RData"))             #reader independent age errors
load(paste0(dir,"fitcomb2.year500000.RData"))             #assuming modal age is true age.
data(Herring_D_boot)
data(HerringSurvey)
data(Ring.readErr)
dataRing = Ring.readErr
```


### Rename variables så ages become right

```{r}
ind = grep("xi0",names(fitcomb0.year))
foo = names(fitcomb0.year)[ind]
for(i in 10:1)
{
  foo = str_replace_all(foo,paste0(",",i,"]"),paste0(",",i+2,"]"))
}
names(fitcomb0.year)[ind] = foo
foo2 = list()
foo3 = substring(foo,first=5,last=5)
foo4 = substring(foo,first=7,last=8)
foo4[1:15] = substring(foo4[1:15],first=1,last=1)
for(i in 1:length(foo))
  foo2[[i]] = substitute(expression(x[i,j]^0),list(i=foo3[i],j=foo4[i]))

##Rename M1 so ages become right
## Commented out, already renamed
ind = grep("M1",names(fitcomb0.year))
ind2 = matrix(nrow=length(ind),ncol=3)
i=0
for(a in 1:A)
  for(a2 in 1:A)
    for(r in 1:R)
    {
      i = i+1
      ind2[i,] = c(r,a+Amin-1,a2+Amin-1)
    }
names(fitcomb0.year)[ind] = paste0("M1[",ind2[,1],",",ind2[,2],",",ind2[,3],"]")
```



### Calculating marginal likelihoods

```{r}
#Harmonic mean for marginal likelihood
foo0 = as.vector(extract(fitcomb0.year)$loglik)
ML0 = max(foo0)-log(mean(exp(-foo0+max(foo0))))
foo1 = as.vector(extract(fitcomb1.year)$loglik)
ML1 = max(foo1)-log(mean(exp(-foo1+max(foo1))))
foo2 = extract(fitcomb2.year)$lp__
ML2 = max(foo2)-log(mean(exp(-foo2+max(foo2))))

```




### Calculating number at age

```{r}
Bootmean = Herring_D_boot[Herring_D_boot$BootstrapID<2,]
nunit = length(unique(Bootmean$unitstrat))
#Only using mean of bootstrap samples
for(i in 1:nunit)
{
  Bootmean$Abundance[Bootmean$unitstrat==i] = mean(Herring_D_boot$Abundance[Herring_D_boot$unitstrat==i])
  Bootmean$Biomass[Bootmean$unitstrat==i] = mean(Herring_D_boot$Biomass[Herring_D_boot$unitstrat==i])
}

if(!file.exists("../save_results/res0fit0.RData"))
{
 foo = rstan::extract(fitcomb0.year)$xi1
 res0 = Make_Numfish_sample(foo,Herring_D_boot,HerringSurvey$stratayearindex)
 res0mean = Make_Numfish_sample(foo,Bootmean,HerringSurvey$stratayearindex)
 foo2 = array(apply(foo,2:3,mean),c(1,15,10))
 res0mean2 = Make_Numfish_sample(foo2,Herring_D_boot,HerringSurvey$stratayearindex)
 save(res0,file="../save_results/res0fit0.RData")
 save(res0mean,file="../save_results/res0meanfit0.RData")
 save(res0mean2,file="../save_results/res0mean2fit0.RData")
}
if(file.exists("../save_results/res0fit0.RData"))
{
  load("../save_results/res0fit0.RData")
  load("../save_results/res0meanfit0.RData")
  load("../save_results/res0mean2fit0.RData")
}
if(!file.exists("../save_results/res1fit1.RData"))
{
 foo = rstan::extract(fitcomb1.year)$xi1
 res1 = Make_Numfish_sample(foo,Herring_D_boot,HerringSurvey$stratayearindex)
 res1mean = Make_Numfish_sample(foo,Bootmean,HerringSurvey$stratayearindex)

 save(res1,file="../save_results/res1fit1.RData")
```

### Heatmat av M matriser

```{r}
M1 = extract(fitcomb0.year,pars="M1")$M1
M1mean = apply(M1,c(2,3,4),mean)
##
for(r in c(1,3,5,6))
{
  print(r)
  z_values <- round(t(M1mean[r, , ]), 3)
  df <- expand.grid(x = 2 + 1:A, y = 2 + 1:A)
  df$Prob <- c(t(z_values))
  pdf(paste0("Heatmap_M",r,".pdf"),height=5,width=5)
  ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = Prob)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "black") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "", x = "True age", y = "Read age", fill = "Prob") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(df$x), max(df$x), by = 2)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(min(df$y), max(df$y), by = 2))
  dev.off()
}

```

### MCMC intervals for hyper parameters

```{r}
pdf("fit0_global.pdf",height=6,width=5)
pars = c("Palpha0","Palpha1","Pbeta0","Pbeta1","Ptrphi")
xx =as.matrix(fitcomb0.year,pars=pars)
mcmc_intervals(xx,prob=0.8,prob_outer=0.95)+scale_y_discrete(labels=c(expression(alpha[0]),expression(alpha[1]),expression(beta[0]),expression(beta[1]),"Ptrphi"))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.title.x=element_text(size=22),axis.title.y=element_text(size=22))
#plot(fitcomb0.year,pars=pars)
dev.off()
```

### Making legend figure for numbers-at-age plots, three different M-assumtions

```{r}
dummy_df <- data.frame(
  Method = factor(1:3, levels = 1:3),
  x = 1:3,
  y = 1:3
)
#cols <- c("steelblue", "firebrick", "darkgreen")
cols <- scales::hue_pal()(3)
legend_plot <- ggplot(dummy_df, aes(x = x, y = y, color = Method)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = cols,
    labels = c("Reader dependent error matrix","Common error matrix","No uncertainties")
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      title = NULL,
      override.aes = list(shape=15,size = 6)
    )
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "lines")
  )

legend_grob <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot)
```


### Numbers-at-age for 2022 for agegroups 5-7, comparing three M-structures

```{r}
l = list()
ind = 0
y = 2
mean0 = round(apply(res0[,y,],2,mean)/10^9,2)
sd0 = round(apply(res0[,y,],2,sd)/10^9,2)
mean0mean = round(apply(res0mean[,y,],2,mean)/10^9,2)
sd0mean = round(apply(res0mean[,y,],2,sd)/10^9,2)
mean1 = round(apply(res1[,y,],2,mean)/10^9,2)
sd1 = round(apply(res1[,y,],2,sd)/10^9,2)
mean2 = round(apply(res2[,y,],2,mean)/10^9,2)
sd2 = round(apply(res2[,y,],2,sd)/10^9,2)
for(a in 3:5)
{
  ind = ind+1
  df = data.frame(y=c(res0[,y,a],res1[,y,a],res2[,y,a]),
                  Method=c(rep(1,dim(res0)[1]),
                       rep(2,dim(res1)[1]),rep(3,dim(res2)[1])))
  df$y = df$y/10^9
  df$Method = as.factor(df$Method)
  l[[ind]] = ggplot(df,aes(x=y,color=Method,fill=Method)) +
    geom_density(alpha=0.5) +
    ggtitle(paste0("Age=",a+Amin-1)) + xlab('') + ylab('') +
    scale_color_discrete(
      labels = c(
        paste0(mean0[a],"(",sd0[a],")"),
        paste0(mean1[a],"(",sd1[a],")"),
        paste0(mean2[a],"(",sd2[a],")"))) +
    scale_fill_discrete(
      labels = c(
        paste0(mean0[a],"(",sd0[a],")"),
        paste0(mean1[a],"(",sd1[a],")"),
        paste0(mean2[a],"(",sd2[a],")"))) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(title = NULL),
      fill  = guide_legend(title = NULL)
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = c(1,1),legend.justification = c(1, 1),
          legend.text=element_text(size=10),
          legend.key.size = unit(0.6, "lines"),
          legend.title = element_blank())
}
pdf("Nest_age345_2022.pdf",height=2.5,width=10)
grid.arrange(l[[1]],l[[2]],l[[3]],legend_grob,ncol=4,nrow=1)
dev.off()
```

### Making legend plot for comparing different bootstrap estimates

```{r}
dummy_df <- data.frame(
  Method = factor(1:2, levels = 1:2),
  x = 1:2,
  y = 1:2
)
cols <- scales::hue_pal()(2)
legend_plot <- ggplot(dummy_df, aes(x = x, y = y, color = Method)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = cols,
    labels = c("Equation (7)","Equation (8)")
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      title = NULL,
      override.aes = list(shape=15,size = 6)
    )
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "lines")
  )

legend_grob2 <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot)
```

```{r}
for(y in 1:3)
{
  age = NULL
  val = NULL
  met = NULL
  M = dim(res0)[1]
  M2 = dim(res0mean)[1]
  #M = 500
  for(a in 1:A)
  {
    age = c(age,rep(2+a,M))
    val = c(val,res0[1:M,y,a])
    met = c(met,rep(0,M))
    age = c(age,rep(2+a,M))
    val = c(val,res1[1:M,y,a])
    met = c(met,rep(1,M))
    age = c(age,rep(2+a,M))
    val = c(val,res2[1:M,y,a])
    met = c(met,rep(2,M))
    age = c(age,rep(2+a,M2))
    val = c(val,res0mean[1:M2,y,a])
    met = c(met,rep(3,M2))
  }
  df = data.frame(age=factor(age),value=val,method=as.factor(met))
  summary_df <- df %>%
    group_by(age, method) %>%
    summarise(
      ymin   = min(value),
      lower  = quantile(value, 0.25),
      middle = median(value),
      upper  = quantile(value, 0.75),
      ymax   = max(value),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  pdf(paste0("Nest_boxplot_",2020+y,".pdf"),height=6,width=10)
  ggplot(summary_df,
         aes(x = age, fill = method)) +
    geom_boxplot(
      aes(
        ymin = ymin,
        lower = lower,
        middle = middle,
        upper = upper,
        ymax = ymax
      ),
      stat = "identity",
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  #ggplot(ddf, aes(x = factor(age), y = value, fill = model)) +
  #  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  #  labs(x = "Age", y = "Value") +
  #  scale_fill_manual(
  #    values = c("0" = "red","1" = "green","2" = "blue","3" = "cyan")) +
  #  theme_minimal()
  dev.off()
}
```
